description: PTX corpus for libs/ptxparse (wave-2 todo 9). Every kernel statistic is asserted EXACTLY by libs/ptxparse/tests/ptxparse_test.cpp. parse_only=true marks hand-written fixtures that are never assembled (the tcgen05 fixture per the FIXTURE GENERATION RULE: nvcc 12.6 cannot target sm_100); parse_only=false marks nvcc 12.6 -ptx generated fixtures (mma_sm80: nvcc -arch=sm_80 -ptx; wgmma_sm90: nvcc -arch=sm_90a -ptx).

fixtures.description: Hand-written trivial kernel: mov from %tid.x, bar.sync 0, ret.
Hand-written predicated branch on a threadIdx-derived value (lane parity): @%p1 bra with explicit fallthrough label; 4 blocks, 4 CFG edges.
Hand-written shared-memory stride pattern (bank-conflict stride of 68 words, cf. brief §3): one ld.shared + one st.shared, .shared .align 4 declaration.
nvcc 12.6 -arch=sm_80 -ptx from a tiny .cu with mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16 inline asm (generator source: mma_sm80.cu, committed under tests/ptxparse/README.md provenance note).
nvcc 12.6 -arch=sm_90a -ptx from a tiny .cu with wgmma.mma_async.m64n64k16 inline asm plus wgmma.commit_group / wgmma.wait_group.sync.aligned.

HAND-WRITTEN per PTX ISA 8.6+ syntax (FIXTURE GENERATION RULE): nvcc 12.6 cannot target sm_100 (Blackwell needs CUDA >= 12.8), so this corpus is parse-only - never assembled, never ptxas-validated. Exercises tcgen05.alloc/mma/ld/st/commit/wait/dealloc with cta_group::, kind::, shared::cta and mbarrier::complete_tx::bytes suffixes. Every tensor op carries parse_only=true.
